sloka: उग्रेण तपसा युक्ताम् ददौ शैलवरः सुताम् ।रुद्राय अप्रतिरूपाय उमाम् लोक नमस्कृताम् ॥१-३५-२१॥
transliteration: ugreṇa tapasā yuktām dadau śailavaraḥ sutām ।rudrāya apratirūpāya umām loka namaskṛtām ॥1-35-21॥

translations.english: Himavan the best of mountains gave his daughter Uma associated with severe austerities and venerated by the whole world in marriage to the unrivalled Rudra.
